title: weapons of miracles Japanese translation pack
description: weapons of miracles Japanese translation resource pack.
body:
This is WOM JAPANESE TRANSLATION PACK.

これはweapons of miraclesの日本語化リソースパックです。



This resource pack was created using epic fight ver  14.15.1 and WoM ver 2.0.15.

 Using earlier versions may cause the game to crash.

-------日本語---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

これはWoMの日本語化リソースパックです。

武器、武器のスキル内容、スキルブック、敵を全て日本語化しました。

ただ、epicfight:skill tree内のスキル開放条件等が翻訳できておりません。その点についてはご了承ください。



WoM本体の作者のReascerに感謝します。

WoM本体-by reascer

英語の文章は翻訳サイト：Deeplを用いられ作成されました。

日本文はリソースパック作者本人が作成しました。

--------------------English---------------------------------------------------------------

This is a Japanese language resource pack for WoM.

Weapons, weapon skill descriptions, skill books and enemies have all been localised into Japanese.

However, please note that the skill unlock conditions and other details within the “epicfight:skill tree” have not been translated. We appreciate your understanding regarding this matter.



I would like to thank Reascer, the creator of the WoM.

weapons of miracles - by reascer



The English text was generated using the translation website Deepl.

The Japanese text was written by the resource pack author themselves.



何かバグが発生した場合、コメントやdiscordのDMにてお問い合わせください。

If you encounter any bugs, please let us know via the comments or a direct message on Discord.
